title: .semlayer/change.json
description: The open change round of a released layer, written by semlayer change start and removed by semlayer change close. Committed; holds the owner's note, a name, a time and a version, never a data value, URL or credential.

note.description: What the round is for, in the owner's words.

started_at.description: When the round started, from the command's clock.

from_version.description: The layer version the round started from, the last release in changelog.yaml.
